pages.title: Virginia Opossum
pages.text: The Virginia opossum ($(o)Didelphis virginiana$()) is a marsupial found from southern Canada through the United States and Mexico into Central America.$(br2)It is the only marsupial native to North America north of Mexico. Like other marsupials, females raise their young in a pouch.$(br2)The Virginia opossum is an omnivore with a prehensile tail and 50 teeth. When threatened, it may play dead, a behaviour known as "playing possum".
